# T6.2 (TASKS.md) -- DESIGN.md §3 degenerate-case table, row "Leader
# deposed right after announcing heir": the leader is deposed immediately
# after its first heir announcement; the announcement is soft state (T4.4)
# and is cleared on the term bump every node sees when the new leader takes
# over, so nothing is inherited. The new leader then runs its own
# selection from scratch and announces its own heir.
#
# Scores are arranged so this is unambiguous rather than a coincidence:
# under the *old* leader (1), the eligible pool is {2,3} and 2 (100) wins.
# The *new* leader is 2 itself (deposes 1), so its own eligible pool is
# {1,3} -- a completely different pair -- and 1 (255) wins. The heir
# genuinely changes identity (2 -> 1), which a leftover/inherited belief
# could not produce, since the old belief never mentioned node 1 at all.

log-level error
----
ok

add-nodes 1 voters=(1,2,3) index=2 heir-election=true stability-score=255
----
ok

add-nodes 1 voters=(1,2,3) index=2 heir-election=true stability-score=100
----
ok

add-nodes 1 voters=(1,2,3) index=2 heir-election=true stability-score=50
----
ok
